response.justification: Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with 18+ years of experience and is currently working on AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq, including MCP frameworks. However, the position requires 8+ years of production-grade AI solution development, which is not demonstrated on this resume. His background is primarily web, backend, and systems engineering rather than AI/GenAI products. While he has TypeScript expertise and cloud infrastructure knowledge, there is no evidence of work with vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM optimization, or leading technical discovery with enterprise customers—key requirements for this Staff-level role.
strengths: 18+ years of software development with multiple Staff-level positions demonstrating deep technical skills and mentoring capabilities across complex systems
Currently contributing to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq, showing active engagement with GenAI tooling and agentic workflows
Strong TypeScript/Node.js expertise, cloud infrastructure knowledge (AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker), and proven ability to build scalable, high-performance systems
concerns: No demonstrated experience building and shipping production-grade AI/ML solutions; career trajectory is primarily web and backend development, not GenAI/AI products
Missing required AI technologies and expertise: no mention of vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM optimization, or production language model work
No evidence of customer-facing technical leadership in discovery/consulting contexts or building evaluation and observability frameworks for AI systems as required

key_factors.factor: Recent AI infrastructure and MCP work at re:cinq
Strong software engineering fundamentals and TypeScript expertise
